name: The Road to Darnassus
summary: Travelers on Teldrassil’s western road face attacks from corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs. Moon Priestess Amara coordinates scouts and travelers to keep the route from Dolanaar to Darnassus clear for trade and messages.

sections.title: A Lifeline Under Siege
sections.body: You travel west from Dolanaar toward Darnassus on Teldrassil’s main road. Goods, political messages, and travelers pass this way each day, linking the capital with the boughs of the great tree. Teldrassil is young and wild, so its kaldorei communities depend on safe roads.

sections.title: The Gnarlpine Menace
sections.body: The Gnarlpine furbolgs have been driven mad by a sickness in the boughs of the World Tree. They attack from dens beneath the ridges. Along the road, ambushers stalk the tree line and prey on couriers and travelers, making the passage through the forest deadly.

sections.title: The Sentinels' Vigil
sections.body: Moon Priestess Amara watches over the road outside Dolanaar. She joins the spiritual authority of Elune’s priesthood with the Sentinels’ vigilance. Amara directs capable travelers to strike at ambushers near their dens below the road. The route to Darnassus’s gates depends on keeping them at bay.

faq.q: Why is the road between Dolanaar and Darnassus so dangerous?
faq.answer: Corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs have made dens along the low ridges below the road. Sickness spreading through Teldrassil has driven them mad, and they attack travelers, couriers, and merchants from the underbrush.

aliases: who gives the road to darnassus quest
faq.answer: Moon Priestess Amara, also addressed by her full name, Sentinel Amara Nightwalker, is a night elf commander on Dolanaar’s western outskirts. She oversees the road’s security and coordinates efforts against the nearby Gnarlpine.

faq.q: Why are the Gnarlpine furbolgs aggressive?
faq.answer: Furbolgs were once peaceful allies and neighbors of the kaldorei. A strange malady infecting the World Tree has twisted the Gnarlpine on Teldrassil, making them violent and driving them to attack anyone entering the forest.
The ambushers hide below the bluffs and vantage points just off the main road west of Dolanaar. From their dens, they can leap upon travelers heading toward Darnassus.

faq.q: Why doesn't Darnassus send a full Sentinel garrison to clear the road?
faq.answer: The Sentinels are spread thin across Teldrassil, facing grell infestations, corrupted timberlings, and threats along the coast. Officers like Amara rely on capable travelers and volunteers to keep the interior roads clear.

faq.q: Why is Amara called both a Moon Priestess and a Sentinel?
faq.answer: In kaldorei society, Elune’s sisterhood and the Sentinel military are closely linked. Leaders in the priesthood often command Sentinel troops or have served as front-line warriors.

angles.text: The Gnarlpine were once honorable kindred of the wild. Putting down corrupted ambushers on the road to Darnassus is a grim necessity born of Teldrassil’s sickness.
As a priest, you aid Moon Priestess Amara and the Sisterhood of Elune. The sisterhood gives spiritual leadership and martial defense to the young tree.
As an Alliance traveler, you help keep trade and messages moving safely along the main road to Darnassus, the heart of the Alliance presence in northern Kalimdor.
